Sweet Dog Who Was Hit By Car & Left On Road is Now Looking For Love
Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet Osa, a sweet girl who has overcome many hardships in life and is now ready for a new chapter of happiness. Osa’s early life remains a mystery, but she somehow found herself living as a stray on the streets of Mexico. A Good Samaritan found Oso lying injured on the road after being hit by a car. Oso was taken to a dog Sanctuary outside Mexico City and was given treatment for her injuries. Some time later, Great Dog Rescue New England’s directors met her when visiting the Sanctuary and said, “They could not leave this sweet girl behind and flew her home to Boston with them.” Now Oso is living locally with a foster family who adores her, while she awaits the true forever family she is destined for.
